description: SPRINT_PLAN Amendment 9 (pre-registered 2026-11-01, before any factory run): the 10-year strategy factory. Every strategy with code, one run each, SPY+QQQ+IWM pooled, desk fills, 2% half-spread ($0.005 floor), $0.65/contract/side, 1 contract, one position at a time per run and symbol: noise (its own exit), orb15/30/60, vwap_macd, pd_retest, flush (both sides, plain exit), failed_break calls, failed_high puts (plain exit), far-OTM calls (d03-12t07) and puts (d06-15t10) at 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00 and 14:00 (-95% stop, +9900% target, all out 15:25). 21 runs. No pass-2 robustness (tools/sprint_factory.py does its own checks). DEV = 2024-08-01..2026-06-30, REAL Alpaca option prices (run with an empty --chains-dir so the pre-registered 2% MODELED-SPREAD is used, never logged 2026 chains).

blocks.name: noise
blocks.why: the reference strategy (noise ledger, Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon 2024): its own exit (band/VWAP at the half-hour checks, reversal, 20% premium ceiling every minute), its own delta 0.55-0.75 contract, both sides
